content.rendered:
Sherwood High School offers a variety of clubs and activities based on student interest.  Linked below is a list of the currently active clubs and activities at SHS and their advisors.  Unless otherwise indicated with an email address,  these advisors are staff at SHS.  If you are interested in forming a new club, please see Katie Rarick in room M209. The new club application is available below.

Interested in starting a new club? Applications are available in the leadership classroom. Submit completed applications to Mrs. Rarick.
